title: Human Resource Recruiter
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 HR Recruiter IT & Non-IT 
 Company: Ramxora Private Limited
 Department: Human Resources / Talent Acquisition
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Work Location: Mahadevapura, Bengaluru Onsite
 Experience: 12 Years
 Working Days: 5 Days a Week
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 About the Role 
Ramxora Private Limited is looking for an energetic, organized, and target-oriented HR Recruiter IT & Non-IT to join our Human Resources / Talent Acquisition team.
The candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process for both IT and Non-IT positions, including understanding manpower requirements, sourcing candidates, screening profiles, conducting initial HR discussions, coordinating technical and management interviews, maintaining recruitment records, negotiating compensation, and supporting candidates through the joining process.
The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of IT recruitment, Non-IT recruitment, job portals, LinkedIn sourcing, Boolean search, candidate screening, interview coordination, salary negotiation, recruitment MIS, and onboarding coordination .

 1. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition 
 Manage the end-to-end recruitment cycle from requirement gathering to candidate joining. Understand job requirements, technical skills, experience, qualifications, compensation range, notice period, and other hiring criteria. Work closely with HR, hiring managers, technical leads, department heads, and management to understand manpower requirements. Prepare and publish accurate Job Descriptions (JDs) for IT and Non-IT positions. Source candidates through multiple recruitment channels. Maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified candidates for current and upcoming requirements. Follow up with candidates regularly throughout the recruitment process. Ensure timely closure of assigned vacancies. B. IT Recruitment 
Handle recruitment for various technology roles such as:
 Software Developers Full Stack Developers Front-End Developers Backend Developers Python Developers Java Developers MERN Developers React.js / Next.js Developers Mobile App Developers QA / Software Test Engineers Automation Test Engineers DevOps Engineers Cloud Engineers AWS / Azure / GCP Engineers UI/UX Designers Data Engineers AI/ML Engineers AI/LLM Engineers Technical Product Managers Project Managers Business Analysts Technical Support Engineers Other IT and SaaS-related positions The recruiter should be able to understand basic technical terminology and identify whether a candidate's profile broadly matches the JD before forwarding it to the technical team.
 C. Non-IT Recruitment 
Handle recruitment for positions such as:
 HR Executives HR Recruiters HR Managers Sales Executives Business Development Executives BDE / BDM Inside Sales Marketing Executives Digital Marketing Content Writers Operations Executives Administration Finance / Accounts Customer Support Telecalling Office Administration Other corporate and operational positions 
 2. Candidate Sourcing 
Use multiple channels to identify and attract suitable candidates.
 Recruitment Platforms 
 Naukri LinkedIn Indeed TimesJobs Foundit Internshala Other relevant job portals Other Sourcing Methods 
 LinkedIn Recruiter / LinkedIn sourcing Boolean search X-Ray search Database search Employee referrals Internal candidate database Social media recruitment Direct candidate outreach Recruitment communities and professional networks References and employee networks The recruiter should continuously develop and maintain a candidate database/talent pool for frequently hired positions.

 3. Job Posting & Job Portal Management 
 Post vacancies across relevant job portals. Create attractive and accurate job advertisements. Ensure JDs clearly mention: Job title Experience Skills Location Work mode Salary/CTC range where applicable Responsibilities Qualification Interview process 
 Monitor applications received from different platforms. Search existing databases using appropriate keywords. Refresh and optimize job postings when required. Maintain records of job postings and candidate responses. 
 4. Resume Screening & Shortlisting 
 Review resumes received from job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and other sources. Compare candidate profiles against the approved JD. Check: Relevant experience Technical skills Industry experience Educational qualification Current location Notice period Current CTC Expected CTC Career stability Relevant project experience 
 Identify employment gaps or frequent job changes where relevant. Shortlist candidates who meet the basic requirements. Avoid forwarding profiles that clearly do not match the mandatory requirements. Maintain proper screening notes for shortlisted candidates. 
 5. Initial HR Screening 
Conduct initial telephonic/online HR screening with candidates.
Evaluate:
 Communication skills Professional attitude Relevant experience Technical exposure at a basic screening level Current role and responsibilities Project experience Career objectives Notice period Current CTC Expected CTC Location Relocation willingness Work-from-office / hybrid / remote preference Reason for job change Availability for interviews Overall suitability for the position Maintain proper screening records and share relevant candidate information with the hiring team.

 6. Interview Coordination 
 Coordinate technical, HR, managerial, and final-round interviews. Schedule interviews based on interviewer and candidate availability. Send interview invitations and joining instructions. Confirm candidate availability before every interview. Share candidate profiles and screening details with interviewers. Follow up with interview panels for feedback. Update candidates regarding interview status. Reschedule interviews when required. Minimize interview no-shows through proper follow-up. Candidate Follow-Up 
Maintain regular communication with candidates regarding:
 Interview schedule Interview confirmation Feedback Next rounds Documentation Salary discussion Offer status Joining date Joining confirmation 
 7. Candidate Evaluation & Feedback Management 
 Collect interview feedback from interviewers on time. Maintain accurate interview status. Communicate selection/rejection/hold status professionally. Maintain candidate records throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Escalate delayed feedback to the appropriate HR/hiring manager. Ensure candidates are not left without communication for extended periods. 
 8. Salary Discussion & Negotiation 
 Discuss salary expectations during the initial screening stage. Understand the candidate's current CTC and expected CTC. Communicate the approved salary budget transparently where applicable. Identify compensation mismatches at an early stage. Negotiate within the approved company budget. Coordinate with management/HR for exceptional compensation cases. Avoid proceeding with candidates whose expectations are clearly outside the approved budget unless specifically authorized. Maintain confidentiality of compensation information. 
 9. Offer & Pre-Joining Coordination 
After candidate selection:
 Collect required candidate information. Coordinate salary approval. Prepare/share offer-related information with HR. Follow up for offer acceptance. Confirm expected joining date. Maintain regular pre-joining communication. Send joining reminders. Track candidates who have accepted offers. Identify potential dropouts before joining. Maintain backup candidates for critical positions. Coordinate documentation required for joining. 
 10. Joining & Onboarding Support 
Support HR in the joining process by coordinating:
 Joining date confirmation Reporting time Required documents Employee information Offer/appointment documentation Policy acknowledgement Background verification where applicable HR induction coordination Department introduction Employee onboarding status Maintain accurate records of candidates who have:
 Applied Screened Shortlisted Interviewed Selected Offered Accepted Joined 

 11. Recruitment MIS & Reporting 
Maintain daily/weekly/monthly recruitment reports.
Track:
 Total requirements Open positions Profiles sourced Profiles screened Profiles shortlisted Interviews scheduled Interviews completed Selected candidates Offers released Offers accepted Candidates joined Candidates rejected Candidates on hold Candidate dropouts Notice periods Source of candidates Time taken to close positions Prepare recruitment MIS reports for HR and management whenever required.

 12. Recruitment Performance Metrics 
The recruiter will be expected to monitor and improve:
 Number of profiles sourced Number of qualified profiles Screening-to-interview ratio Interview-to-selection ratio Selection-to-joining ratio Offer acceptance rate Joining conversion rate Time-to-hire Time-to-close Source effectiveness Candidate quality Interview attendance rate Candidate dropout rate 
 13. Stakeholder Coordination 
Work closely with:
 Senior HR HR Manager Hiring Managers Technical Managers Team Leads Project Managers Department Heads Management Understand hiring priorities and provide regular updates regarding recruitment progress.

 14. Candidate Relationship Management 
 Build professional relationships with candidates. Maintain a strong candidate pipeline. Keep potential candidates engaged for future requirements. Maintain a database of rejected/hold candidates who may fit future openings. Ensure professional communication even when candidates are rejected. Protect candidate confidentiality and personal information. Represent the company professionally during candidate interactions. 
 15. Recruitment Process Improvement 
 Identify bottlenecks in the hiring process. Suggest improvements to sourcing and screening methods. Improve candidate response and interview attendance rates. Explore new recruitment channels. Maintain updated sourcing strategies for difficult-to-hire technical positions. Develop talent pools for recurring positions. Track recruitment trends and competitor hiring practices. 
 16. Basic Technical Understanding IT Recruitment 
The recruiter should have a basic understanding of commonly used technology terms, including:
 Programming / Development 
 Python Java JavaScript TypeScript Node.js React.js Next.js Angular .NET Backend / API 
 REST API FastAPI Django Flask Express.js Database 
 MySQL PostgreSQL MongoDB Redis Cloud / DevOps 
 AWS Azure Google Cloud Docker Kubernetes CI/CD Git Linux AI / ML 
 Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Generative AI LLM RAG Vector Database Prompt Engineering Embeddings The recruiter is not expected to be a technical expert , but should understand the basic terminology sufficiently to identify relevant profiles and conduct an initial screening.

 17. Non-IT Recruitment Knowledge 
The recruiter should be capable of understanding and hiring for business functions such as:
 Sales Marketing Finance Accounts HR Administration Operations Customer Support Business Development Management Back-office operations The recruiter should understand differences between job roles and identify candidates based on relevant experience rather than only job titles.

 18. Required Skills 
 Technical / Recruitment Skills 
 Job portal handling LinkedIn sourcing Boolean search Resume screening Candidate database management Interview scheduling Recruitment MIS Excel / Google Sheets Email communication Basic ATS knowledge Candidate tracking Soft Skills 
 Excellent verbal communication Good written communication Strong follow-up skills Negotiation skills Time management Multitasking Team coordination Problem-solving Professional attitude Attention to detail Target orientation Candidate relationship management 
 19. Qualification 
 Education: 
 Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage. Experience: 
 12 years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition. Experience handling both IT and Non-IT recruitment is preferred. Candidates with experience in IT staffing, SaaS, software companies, technology startups, or recruitment agencies will be preferred. 
 20. Preferred Candidate Profile 
The ideal candidate should:
 Have hands-on recruitment experience. Be comfortable handling multiple vacancies simultaneously. Have experience sourcing candidates through job portals and LinkedIn. Understand basic IT technologies and job roles. Have strong candidate screening skills. Be comfortable with targets and recruitment timelines. Have excellent follow-up and coordination skills. Be comfortable communicating with candidates and hiring managers. Be organized and capable of maintaining recruitment MIS. Be proactive in finding candidates rather than relying only on applications. 
 21. Key Competencies 
 CompetencyExpected Level IT RecruitmentGoodNon-IT RecruitmentGoodCandidate SourcingGoodResume ScreeningGoodLinkedIn SourcingGoodJob Portal ManagementGoodBoolean SearchGoodInterview CoordinationExcellentSalary NegotiationGoodCandidate Follow-upExcellentRecruitment MISGoodCommunicationExcellentStakeholder ManagementGoodTime ManagementExcellentMultitaskingExcellent
 22. Performance Expectations 
During the first few months, the recruiter is expected to demonstrate the ability to:
 Understand company recruitment requirements quickly. Source relevant candidates consistently. Maintain an active candidate pipeline. Reduce irrelevant profile submissions. Coordinate interviews efficiently. Maintain accurate recruitment records. Improve candidate response and interview attendance. Close assigned positions within agreed timelines. Maintain professional candidate communication. Support the HR team in meeting overall manpower requirements. 
 23. Key Deliverables 
The HR Recruiter will be responsible for:
 Timely sourcing of qualified candidates. Effective screening and shortlisting. Maintaining candidate pipelines. Coordinating interviews. Collecting interview feedback. Supporting salary discussions. Managing offer follow-ups. Ensuring joining confirmations. Maintaining recruitment MIS. Supporting successful closure of IT and Non-IT vacancies. Maintaining candidate database. Providing regular recruitment updates to HR and management. 
 Job Summary 
 Position: HR Recruiter IT & Non-IT
 Experience: 12 Years
 Department: Human Resources / Talent Acquisition
 Location: Mahadevapura, Bengaluru
 Work Mode: Onsite
 Employment: Full-Time
 Working Days: 5 Days
The selected candidate will play an important role in building the organization's workforce by managing end-to-end IT and Non-IT recruitment , maintaining strong candidate pipelines, coordinating with hiring teams, and ensuring timely and quality hiring.

Key Skills: IT Recruitment,Non IT Recruitment,Sourcing,End to End Recruitment,Talent Acquisition,Resource,Recruitment,Human resource management

Role & responsibilities 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced US & UK IT Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment for technology positions across the US and UK markets. The role involves understanding technical requirements, sourcing candidates through multiple channels, conducting initial screening, coordinating interviews, managing offers, and ensuring successful candidate closures. Work closely with clients, hiring managers, account managers, and internal stakeholders to understand job requirements. Assess candidates based on technical skills, experience, communication, location, availability, compensation/rate expectations, and work authorization. Maintain strong candidate pipelines for both active and passive candidates . Coordinate interviews, collect feedback, manage follow-ups, and support candidates throughout the hiring process. Handle salary/rate negotiation and candidate closure within approved budgets. Maintain accurate candidate and requisition information in ATS/CRM systems . Meet agreed sourcing, submission, interview, and placement targets/TATs . Maintain regular communication with candidates to ensure a smooth recruitment experience. Experience working with direct clients, MSP/VMS, staffing vendors, or implementation partners is preferred. Knowledge of Permanent, Contract, and Contract-to-Hire hiring models. Basic understanding of UK Right to Work requirements and relevant candidate documentation. title: PBCS Functional Consultant - Immediate Hiring - Mastek
description:
Please find the job description for the role of Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant. 
 Job Title: Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud or Hyperion Planning Company: Mastek Limited Location: Ahmedabad/Mumbai/Noida/Chennai/Trichy/Hyderabad (Hybrid) Shift : UK/US Shift 
 About Us 
 Mastek Limited is a trusted digital engineering and cloud transformation partner for enterprises across the globe. The company focuses on delivering business value through technology, combining deep domain expertise with modern engineering practices. Teams at Mastek collaborate in an inclusive environment that values integrity, learning, and innovation. Mastek is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where every individual is respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. 
 Job Summary 
 Mastek is seeking a proficient Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant to join the Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) practice. The consultant will be responsible for designing, configuring, and supporting Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (PBCS) solutions for enterprise clients, primarily in the finance domain. The role involves working closely with finance stakeholders to understand budgeting, forecasting, and reporting requirements, translating them into scalable Oracle PBCS solutions, and ensuring smooth implementation and adoption. This position is ideal for a finance professional (CA or MBA Finance) with hands-on Oracle PBCS experience and a strong interest in technology-enabled performance management. 
 Key Responsibilities 
Solution Design & Implementation Collaborate with business and finance stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document planning, budgeting, and forecasting requirements. Design end-to-end Oracle PBCS solutions, including data models, forms, business rules, calculations, and workflows. Configure PBCS applications (modules, dimensions, hierarchies, security, and metadata) in line with best practices. Develop and maintain input forms, dashboards, reports, and task lists to support planning and reporting processes. Participate in full project lifecycle activities: requirement analysis, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Functional & Process Expertise
 Map existing financial planning and budgeting processes to Oracle PBCS capabilities and recommend process improvements. Design and implement driver-based planning models, rolling forecasts, and scenario planning. Work with finance teams to align PBCS solutions with corporate budgeting, management reporting, and financial consolidation processes. Provide functional guidance on integration with upstream and downstream systems (ERP, data warehouses, reporting tools). Configuration, Testing & Documentation
 Configure business rules, calculations, allocations, and validations within PBCS. Support data integration and data management activities, including data loads, mappings, and validation. Develop and execute test scenarios and test scripts for unit testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Prepare functional design documents, configuration documents, user guides, and training materials. Stakeholder Management & Support
 Serve as a primary functional point of contact for clients on Oracle PBCS-related topics. Conduct user training sessions and workshops to drive solution adoption. Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting issues, and implementing enhancements. Collaborate with technical teams, project managers, and other consultants to ensure timely and quality delivery. Governance & Continuous Improvement
 Adhere to project governance, documentation standards, and change management processes. Stay current with Oracle EPM Cloud / PBCS updates, new features, and industry best practices. Recommend continuous improvements to existing PBCS implementations to enhance performance, usability, and value. 
 Qualifications 5+ years of overall experience, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience as an Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud / Hyperion Planning functional consultant. Proven experience in: Designing and implementing Oracle PBCS planning applications. Building and managing dimensions, metadata, and data forms. Creating and maintaining business rules, calculations, and allocations. Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting processes. Proficient understanding of: Financial planning and analysis (FP&A) concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario planning. Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and key financial metrics. Experience in data integration and data management within PBCS (e.g., Data Management / Data Management integrations, flat file loads, ERP integrations). Skilled in working with stakeholders from finance and IT, translating business requirements into functional solutions. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with other Oracle EPM Cloud modules (e.g., EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS) or on-premises Hyperion applications. Oracle EPM Cloud / PBCS-related certifications. Experience with Oracle ERP (E-Business Suite, Oracle Cloud ERP) or other ERP systems. Exposure to scripting or automation in the EPM context (e.g., Groovy, calculation scripts, EPM Automate). Experience working in consulting environments or on multi-country / global implementations.

Key Skills: PBCS,Epbcs,Hyperion Planning,Hyperion,Oracle EPM,EPM,Planning,Consulting

Poindexter & Co., Inc. & is headquartered in Houston, Texas, USA. POSITION SUMMARY The US Recruiter – Salaried Roles will be responsible for managing the full-cycle recruitment process for salaried positions across the organization’s US operations. The role will partner closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition leadership to understand business requirements, develop effective recruitment strategies, identify and attract qualified candidates, and drive positions through the recruitment process to successful offer and hire. The ideal candidate will have strong experience recruiting for US-based salaried/professional positions and will be comfortable managing multiple requisitions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The recruiter will be expected to build strong candidate pipelines, including passive talent, while providing an excellent candidate and hiring-manager experience. Success in this role will require strong sourcing capability, stakeholder management, candidate assessment skills, organisation, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver against recruitment metrics such as time to fill, quality of hire, pipeline health, and overall hiring outcomes. KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Full-Cycle Recruitment Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for US-based salaried positions, from preparing job requisition and posting it, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, offer, and handoff to onboarding. Manage multiple open requisitions simultaneously while effectively prioritising roles based on business requirements and hiring timelines. Follow established Talent Acquisition processes and procedures to efficiently and effectively fill salaried positions. Partner with hiring managers to understand position requirements, critical competencies, experience, qualifications, and business needs. Develop and execute recruiting plans and sourcing strategies based on the requirements of each position. Maintain ownership of assigned requisitions and proactively communicate progress, challenges, and potential risks. Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Development Utilize job boards, professional networks, internal databases, referrals, and other recruiting resources to identify qualified candidates. Develop strong pipelines of qualified candidates for current and future salaried hiring needs. Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through targeted sourcing and networking. Build and maintain professional networks to support ongoing US salaried recruitment. Research and identify new sourcing channels and approaches to improve candidate generation. Create and maintain compelling job postings aligned with the requirements of each position. Candidate Screening & Assessment Review resumes and applications and evaluate candidate qualifications against position requirements. Conduct initial phone/video screens to assess candidates' work history, education, experience, skills, career interests, compensation expectations, and overall fit. Assess candidates against defined competencies and job requirements and provide recommendations to hiring managers. Maintain a consistent and objective candidate assessment process. Ensure candidates receive timely communication and a positive recruitment experience throughout the hiring process. Coordinate and participate in video and/or onsite interviews as required. Provide guidance to hiring managers on candidate selection and recruitment best practices. Hiring Manager & Stakeholder Partnership Develop strong working relationships with hiring managers and business leaders supporting salaried recruitment. Conduct recruitment intake discussions and establish clear recruiting plans for assigned positions. Consult with hiring managers throughout the recruitment process and provide market and candidate insights. Educate new hiring managers on Talent Acquisition processes, workflows, interview practices, and expectations. Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition leadership to address recruitment challenges and hiring risks. Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding pipeline status, candidate activity, interview progress, and expected hiring timelines. Offer & Pre-Employment Process Manage the candidate offer process in partnership with the hiring manager and appropriate HR stakeholders. Coordinate required background checks and other pre-employment activities. Maintain timely communication with candidates throughout the offer and pre-employment process. Support the transition of selected candidates into the onboarding process. Reporting & Recruitment Metrics Maintain accurate and timely recruitment activity within the Applicant Tracking System. Track and report recruitment metrics including open requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview activity, offers, time to fill, and hiring status. Provide transparent updates to Talent Acquisition leadership, hiring managers, and HR Business Partners. Proactively identify barriers that may impact hiring timelines and recommend solutions. Maintain accurate records related to recruitment activities and candidate status. Talent Acquisition & Process Improvement Participate in Talent Acquisition initiatives designed to improve recruiting effectiveness and candidate experience. Identify opportunities to improve sourcing strategies, recruiting processes, and candidate pipelines. Support workforce planning and recruitment initiatives as required. Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for salaried recruitment. Complete special projects and other Talent Acquisition activities as assigned. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree 5 to 7 years of experience in recruitment, sourcing, Talent Acquisition, or related experience. Experience recruiting for US-based positions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Experience managing full-cycle recruitment processes. Strong experience sourcing and screening candidates for salaried/professional positions. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with candidates, hiring managers, and senior stakeholders. Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Strong attention to detail and follow-through. Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a Talent Acquisition team. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Proven experience recruiting for US salaried/professional positions. Experience recruiting across multiple business functions. Strong passive candidate sourcing and talent-pipeline development experience. Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting technologies. Experience with Ceridian Dayforce or other comparable ATS/HRIS systems. Experience with LinkedIn and other professional sourcing platforms. Experience partnering directly with US-based hiring managers. Understanding of US recruitment practices and employment requirements. Experience working with recruitment metrics such as time to fill, pipeline conversion, and quality of hire.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Position Title: Executive - HR Reports To: Senior Manager - HR Location: Bangalore About Company We are a digital systems company and a community of passionate, purpose-led individuals seeking to enhance peoples lives with technology. We deliver solutions with speed and at scale to address our customers complex business challenges. We are one of the largest providers of Digital Applications and Technology Solutions on SAP Cloud Platform (SCP) and SAP on-premise platform. To learn more about Incture, visit incture.com Culture at Incture We take pride in trust, transparency and open communication across all levels. You will thrive, if you are open to learning and making a difference in an intrapreneurial and fast-paced environment. We offer competitive salary and perks and a meritocracy driven career growth path. Job Description & Responsibilities We are looking for a results-driven Recruitment Executive to support our IT hiring and staffing business. The role will be responsible for sourcing, screening, engaging and closing technology talent across multiple skill sets, while working closely with hiring managers, business teams and staffing stakeholders. The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to IT recruitment/staffing, lateral hiring, candidate engagement and recruitment delivery , with the ability to manage multiple requirements and hiring priorities simultaneously.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 1. IT Recruitment & Staffing 
 Manage end-to-end recruitment for IT and technology positions across lateral and volume hiring requirements. Understand job requirements, technical skills, experience and business context to identify relevant talent. Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, internal databases, referrals, social platforms and other channels. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals across key technology skill areas. Handle multiple open positions and staffing requirements simultaneously while maintaining delivery timelines. 
 2. Candidate Management 
 Conduct initial screening and assess candidates against technical, experience and behavioural requirements. Drive candidate engagement throughout the recruitment process and ensure a positive candidate experience. Coordinate interviews, feedback, documentation, compensation discussions and offer closure. Maintain regular communication with candidates to improve conversion and reduce drop-offs. Build long-term talent pools for frequently hired technology skills. 
 3. Stakeholder & Hiring Manager Management 
 Work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, delivery teams and business stakeholders to understand current and future hiring needs. Provide regular updates on recruitment progress, pipeline quality, ageing positions and hiring challenges. Seek feedback on candidate quality and continuously refine sourcing and screening strategies. Escalate hiring risks and bottlenecks proactively. 
 4. Staffing / Deployment Support 
 Support staffing requirements by identifying candidates aligned to specific project, client or deployment needs. Work with staffing teams to understand project requirements, availability and deployment timelines. Maintain visibility of candidate status from sourcing through selection, offer and joining. Support quick turnaround hiring for critical project requirements. 
 5. Recruitment Operations & MIS 
 Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment data in the ATS/recruitment trackers. Track key recruitment metrics such as CV submissions, interview ratios, selection ratios, offer-to-join ratios, TAT and ageing positions . Prepare regular recruitment dashboards and hiring reports. Ensure adherence to recruitment processes, documentation and compliance requirements. 
 Success Measures 
The role will be measured on:
 Hiring Delivery | Time-to-Fill | Pipeline Quality | CV-to-Interview Conversion | Interview-to-Selection Conversion | Offer-to-Join Ratio | Candidate Experience | Stakeholder SatisfactionSkills: Strong understanding of IT recruitment and technology staffing Hands-on experience with lateral hiring and volume hiring Good understanding of common IT skills such as Java, .NET, SAP, Cloud, Data, DevOps, Testing, ERP, etc. Strong sourcing and candidate identification skills Good understanding of LinkedIn, job portals and digital sourcing channels Strong candidate engagement and negotiation skills Ability to work on multiple requirements under tight timelines Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Data-driven and target-oriented approach High ownership, responsiveness and follow-through Qualification: Post Graduate Experience Desired: 3-8 Yrs in IT recruitment / IT staffing / RPO / recruitment consulting

title: Talent Acquisition Associate
description:
Talent Acquisition Recruiter Bulk Sales Hiring Job Summary We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Recruiter who is passionate about recruitment and capable of managing high-volume/bulk hiring for Sales roles . The ideal candidate should be strong in sourcing, candidate engagement, interview coordination, and end-to-end recruitment. This role requires a high-ownership, target-driven recruiter who can consistently build quality pipelines and convert them into successful joiners. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment for high-volume Sales hiring. Conduct daily sourcing through Naukri, Apna and other relevant recruitment platforms. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of quality and relevant candidates . Perform high-volume daily candidate calling and screening . Understand candidate experience, skills, communication, salary expectations, location preference and joining availability. Schedule and coordinate interviews with candidates and interview panels. Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Drive daily closures and offer rollouts against hiring requirements. Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and update candidate status on a daily basis. Ensure proper follow-up until joining and onboarding . Maintain a healthy pipeline to support continuous bulk hiring requirements. Work closely with hiring managers and business teams to understand requirements and close positions within timelines. Ensure quality of profiles rather than focusing only on volume. Handle candidate negotiations, offer discussions and joining confirmations. Daily Recruitment Ownership Daily Sourcing Daily Calling Candidate Screening Interview Scheduling Interview Follow-up Selection Offer Rollout Joining Key Skills Strong sourcing skills on Naukri and Apna Good candidate screening and interviewing skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills Ability to handle bulk/high-volume Sales recruitment Strong follow-up and candidate engagement skills Target-oriented and deadline-driven approach Good negotiation skills Ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously Strong Excel/Google Sheets and recruitment tracker skills Ability to work in a fast-paced recruitment environment Experience 0–3 Years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment. Freshers with strong communication skills and a strong interest in recruitment may also be considered. Preferred Experience Candidates with exposure to: Bulk hiring Sales recruitment Inside Sales / Field Sales hiring BDE / BDA / Sales Executive hiring High-volume recruitment Naukri & Apna sourcing What We Expect We are looking for recruiters who can source consistently, make quality calls, build strong pipelines, schedule relevant candidates, drive closures and ensure successful joining . The focus will be on both hiring numbers and candidate quality . Work Schedule 6 Working Days Role Type Full-Time | Talent Acquisition | Bulk Sales Hiring

Key Skills: End to End Recruitment,Hiring,Talent Acquisition,Recruitment,End To End,End,Acquisition

 International Voice Process - Customer Support

Understand customer queries and provide appropriate, timely and accurate resolutions.

Willingness to work in night rotational shifts and rotational weekly offs.

 Basic computer knowledge and ability to work with multiple systems. 
 Candidates should be comfortable with immediate joining. 
 
 
 Interview & Selection Process 
 1. HR Round: Initial screening and communication assessment. 
 2. OPS Round: Operations/process suitability and customer-handling assessment. 
 3. SHL Test: Online assessment as applicable to the hiring process. 
 4. Selection Timeline: Candidates can complete the selection process within 1 day, subject to successful 
 completion of all rounds. 
 5. Interview Mode: Virtual Interview. 
 Compensation & Joining 
 Salary: Up to  5.5 Lakhs per annum, depending on experience, skills, interview performance and applicable 
 company salary structure. 
 Onboarding: Immediate onboarding for selected candidates, subject to completion of the required documentation 
 and company joining formalities. 
 Apply Now 
 If you have strong English communication skills and are looking for an opportunity in an international 
 customer service voice process, apply for this position and be ready for a fast-track virtual selection process.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Manager Talent Acquisition to lead and manage end-to-end recruitment across junior, mid-level, and senior positions. The ideal candidate should have 8+ years of professional experience, with the majority of their career focused on Human Resources and Talent Acquisition . The candidate should have strong expertise in understanding business requirements, developing effective sourcing strategies, managing stakeholders, and successfully closing positions across different levels of the organization. Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills are essential for this role. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead end-to-end Talent Acquisition processes, from understanding manpower requirements to candidate onboarding. Partner closely with business leaders and hiring managers to understand role requirements, team structures, skill requirements, and hiring priorities. Manage hiring for junior, mid-level, and senior positions , with the ability to independently handle critical and leadership-level mandates. Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies using job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, internal talent pools, campus hiring, professional networks, and other relevant channels. Conduct candidate screening and evaluate candidates based on technical/functional skills, experience, cultural fit, career aspirations, and organizational requirements. Own the recruitment pipeline and ensure timely movement of candidates through the various stages of the hiring process. Drive offer negotiation and closure , effectively managing candidate expectations around compensation, role, location, notice period, and career opportunities. Build strong relationships with candidates throughout the recruitment lifecycle to ensure a positive candidate experience. Work closely with senior stakeholders and hiring managers to provide regular updates on hiring progress, challenges, market availability, and expected closure timelines. Provide insights on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, market trends, and competitor hiring practices to support business hiring decisions. Identify bottlenecks in the recruitment process and implement initiatives to improve Time-to-Hire, Quality of Hire, Offer-to-Joining ratio, and overall recruitment efficiency . Maintain accurate recruitment data, dashboards, MIS, and hiring reports. Mentor and guide junior members of the Talent Acquisition team and support them in managing complex hiring requirements. Contribute to the development and implementation of Talent Acquisition strategies, processes, and best practices . Key Skills & Competencies 8+ years of overall professional experience , with substantial experience in HR and Talent Acquisition. Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment across multiple levels and functions. Proven ability to successfully close both junior and senior-level positions , including niche and critical roles. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with candidates and senior stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills . Excellent candidate assessment, interviewing, negotiation, and closing skills. Strong understanding of sourcing channels and recruitment market dynamics. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective hiring strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to recruitment. Ability to manage multiple hiring mandates and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong ownership, accountability, and execution orientation. Ability to work independently while also mentoring and collaborating with the wider TA/HR team. Preferred Profile MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant qualification is preferred. Experience in a corporate Talent Acquisition / HR environment is preferred. Experience handling leadership, managerial, and critical hiring mandates will be an advantage. Prior experience in managing or mentoring a Talent Acquisition team will be preferred. 
 Success in This Role 
 The successful candidate will be expected to build strong stakeholder relationships, maintain a healthy and high-quality talent pipeline, independently drive complex hiring mandates, and consistently deliver timely and quality closures across levels .
